donate.title: Support the community
donate.lead: Every donation helps the synagogue: prayers, holidays, classes and help for those in need. Give once or monthly, in your own name or anonymously.
donate.counter_one: The community has been supported {{count}} time
donate.counter_other: The community has been supported {{count}} times
donate.dedicationsEmpty: Dedications appear here after an editor reviews them
donate.testMode: Payments run in test mode: no real money is charged.

form.title: Donation amount
form.monthlyNote: A monthly donation can be cancelled at any time with the link on the “Thank you” page.
form.dedicationHint: Wish health to a loved one, well-being to your family, honour the memory of the departed. The dedication is published on the site after an editor reviews it.
form.commentHint: The comment is not published on the site.
form.eventNote: The final amount is calculated at checkout using today's ticket price.

slot.prayerOptional: The donation is optional — the prayer will be read in any case.

requisites.lead: You can transfer a donation to the community's account from any bank.
